content: Ceftriaxone for Injection, USP, is provided as a sterile crystalline powder packaged in glass vials. The following packaging options are available: 1. Bulk Pharmacy Containers: These contain 10 grams of ceftriaxone equivalent. Box of 1: NDC 60505-0679-5. Note: This packaging is not intended for direct administration. 2. Vials Containing 250 mg of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Box of 1: NDC 60505-0750-0. Box of 10: NDC 60505-0750-4. 3. Vials Containing 500 mg of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Box of 1: NDC 60505-0751-0. Box of 10: NDC 60505-0751-4. 4. Vials Containing 1 gram of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Box of 1: NDC 60505-0752-0. Box of 10: NDC 60505-0752-4. 5. Vials Containing 2 grams of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Box of 1: NDC 60505-0753-0. Box of 10: NDC 60505-0753-4. 6. Piggyback Bottles Containing 1 gram of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Box of 1: NDC 60505-6087-1. 7. Piggyback Bottles Containing 2 grams of Ceftriaxone Equivalent: Box of 1: NDC 60505-6088-1. Storage Instructions: Ceftriaxone for Injection, USP, in its sterile powder form, should be stored at a temperature range of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F). It must also be protected from light to maintain its stability and efficacy. Manufacturer: D. Searle LLC.
